title: SHFantasy Master Ladder Hardening
scope: Post-review hardening for Daily Blitz ranked settlement, identity, attempt policy, and returning-player UI state.
implemented: Added daily_blitz_rank_events as a unique settlement ledger with entry_id uniqueness.
Added daily_blitz_rank_state as the sport-specific rank source of truth.
Added ranked_status, ranked_attempt_key, season_id, and rules_version snapshots on daily_blitz_entries.
Added a unique ranked attempt key for one ranked settlement per user, sport, slate, season, and rules version.
Converted duplicate same-slate entries into unranked practice hands that can reveal lessons but cannot earn RP.
Changed rank movement from raw score to same-slate percentile.
Kept full-hand and role-diverse bonuses tiny and blocked them from turning negative results into positive RP.
Added authenticated user handling via request state or dev X-SHF-User-ID header.
Rejected mismatched body user_id values and blocked other users from revealing private entries.
Added /daily-blitz/ranked/me for authenticated full rank state.
Changed /daily-blitz/ranked/{user_id} to public-safe display profile only.
Added reveal idempotency through saved rank events.
Added a rank settlement lock for SQLite runtime concurrent reveal protection.
Updated the frontend API wrapper to send X-SHF-User-ID from localStorage.
Updated Daily Blitz to hydrate the active sport rank on load and avoid a returning-player Rookie flash.
review_items_addressed: P1 negative result bonus turning positive
not_done: Not deployed to production in this local run.
Real sports data provider integration remains behind the existing mock/dry-run source until API and budget are approved.
Season soft reset and Diamond/Master inactivity decay are still design-ready but not implemented.
Public leaderboard should remain gated until the deployment owner confirms auth middleware and migration path.
safety: Play-money only. No betting, payment, KYC, deposits, withdrawals, or cash-value prizes.
